quranReading.description: Start from the very beginning: the Arabic letters, their sounds, then reading the Quran fluently from the page.
quranReading.audience: For complete beginners of any age — no Arabic needed.

tajweed.description: Learn Tajweed — the rules for reciting the Quran with correct pronunciation — and practise until it feels natural.
tajweed.audience: For anyone who can already read the Quran and wants to recite it correctly.

hifz.description: Memorise the Quran (Hifz) with a proven daily routine of new lessons and revision, so you keep what you learn.
hifz.audience: For learners who read fluently and want to memorise, a little at a time.

understanding.description: Understand what you recite: common Quranic words, translation, basic Arabic grammar and Tafsir (explanation of the verses).
understanding.audience: For readers who want to know the meaning of the Quran.

islamicStudies.description: The foundations of daily Muslim life: belief, worship, the Prophet's ﷺ life and teachings, manners, duas and history.
islamicStudies.audience: For everyone — children, adults and new Muslims alike.

advanced.description: Deeper study of the Quranic sciences, the recognised recitations (Qira'at) and research into Tafsir.
advanced.audience: For dedicated students aged 16 and over.

teacherPreparation.description: Learn how to teach Qaida, Nazra and Tajweed, assess students and run classes, with supervised practice.
teacherPreparation.audience: For experienced students preparing to teach others.

hero.title: Learn the Quran for free, step by step, with a real teacher
hero.subtitle: Clear lessons for children, adults and new Muslims. Start from the alphabet or continue where you are — at your own pace, on any device.

howItWorks.title: Three simple steps
howItWorks.intro: No fees, no complicated setup. Here is exactly what happens.

steps.title: Create your free account
steps.body: Sign up with your name and email. It takes about a minute and costs nothing — ever.

steps.title: Choose your track
steps.body: Pick where to start, for example reading from the beginning, or improving your recitation. We help you choose.

steps.title: Learn with a teacher
steps.body: Work through short lessons. Your teacher checks what you have learned and signs it off before the next step opens.

path.title: A clear path from the first letter to mastery
path.intro: Every learner moves through four stages. You always know where you are and what comes next.

stages.Foundation: Letters, sounds and the basics of faith.
stages.Practice: Reading, recitation and memorisation with feedback.
stages.Mastery: Advanced study and preparing to teach.

tracks.title: Seven tracks, one connected journey
tracks.intro: Each track builds on the one before it. Start wherever fits you.

learners.title: Comfortable to use, whatever your age

items.title: Children
items.body: Short, friendly lessons. Parents can follow every step from their own dashboard.

items.title: Adults
items.body: Learn around work and family, at your own pace, with a teacher to guide you.

items.title: New Muslims
items.body: Begin with the essentials of faith and prayer, explained simply and kindly.

items.title: Older learners
items.body: Large, clear text, a calm layout and short lessons you can take at your own pace, with a teacher to help.

parents.title: For parents
parents.body: See your child's attendance, progress and homework, and message their teacher directly.

teachers.title: For volunteer teachers
teachers.body: Share your knowledge. Set your own hours, teach live classes and guide students level by level.

items.question: Is it really free?
items.answer: Yes. Every course, class and lesson is free. There are no hidden fees and no subscription.

items.question: Do I need to know Arabic?
items.answer: No. The Quran Reading track starts with the Arabic alphabet, one letter at a time, and explains everything in your language.

items.question: Which languages can I learn in?
items.answer: English, Urdu and Arabic. You can switch language at any time from the top of the page.

items.question: What does "teacher sign-off" mean?
items.answer: After each module your teacher checks that you have understood it — for example by listening to you read. Once they sign it off, the next module opens. This makes sure you never move on too soon.

items.question: Is there an age limit?
items.answer: No. Children, adults and older learners are all welcome. Only the advanced Level 19 (Ulum al-Quran) is for learners aged 16 and over.
